verdict.rationale: RudderStack's docs say its 200+ pre-built integrations, which go beyond its 16 SDKs, let you connect new data sources. They also mention streaming ad platform conversions, which hints at ingesting third-party data rather than only self-instrumented app events. However, the evidence never names specific cloud-app or webhook sources, and the documented non-SDK source (Reverse ETL) pulls from the user's own warehouse or database, not third-party apps. Missing for 10: an explicit catalog of third-party cloud-app/SaaS sources, webhook or feed ingestion documentation, sync scheduling details for those sources, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can pull customer data in from third-party cloud apps and feeds — not just my own instrumented apps

citations.quote: With over 200 pre-built integrations, including 16 SDKs, you can connect new data sources to your entire stack in a matter of minutes.
Stream app events and ad platform conversions to your entire stack
